# Muh. Wardiman (@devwardiman)

> Software & Web Developer based in Makassar, Indonesia. Specialized in full-stack web architectures, PWA monitoring systems, mobile applications (Flutter/Android), and UX design. 7+ years of experience with 100+ projects shipped. Available full-time.

## Core Competencies & Tech Stack
- **Database Architecture**: Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite.
- **Backend & OOP**: Java (OOP), Visual .NET (C#), Node.js, PHP / CodeIgniter 4, RESTful APIs.
- **Frontend & PWA**: Modern JavaScript (ESNext), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Progressive Web Apps (PWA), responsive dashboards.
- **Mobile Engineering**: Android Studio (Kotlin / Java), Flutter cross-platform development.
- **Current Focus / Research**: Vibe coding, technical blogging, open-source development.

## Featured Work & Certifications
- **Sistem Informasi Manajemen & Monitoring Berbasis Web dan Mobile**: End-to-end enterprise platform featuring SQL Server & MySQL data layers, CodeIgniter 4 / Node.js backend services, real-time responsive web administration, and Flutter mobile clients.
- **UX Design For Website (45 JP)**: Professional certification from LPK BABA STUDIO (issued September 1, 2020) covering website UX design principles, UI layout engineering, and interactive web prototyping.
